name: Yellow curry with pork
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai yellow curry with chicken and potato (4 bowls: 1 can coconut milk, 2 tbsp paste, 1 cup chicken, 2 potatoes, 1/2 onion, 1 cup baby corn) with pork; carrot stands in for baby corn. Per bowl 90 g of coconut milk, 14 g of paste, 80 g of water, 70 g of cooked pork.
